caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a human figure with stylized features, standing on a rectangular dark brown or black base. The figure wears a fitted cream or beige jacket with gold accents and buttons, red cuffs, and red epaulettes, paired with bright red pants featuring a gold stripe down the sides. Black shoes complete the attire. The figure has a large, curved mustache and a prominent chin, with a cigar or stick held in its mouth. The head is topped with a red cap featuring a dark band. The arms are crossed over its chest, and the stance is upright and rigid. The background is plain and light, creating contrast with the brightly colored figure.
title: Cigar Store Figure
